_comment: Discovery sources for scripts/curation-discover.sh (Slice 5, specs/marketplace-curation-engine). MONTHLY, model-using, budget-capped (EF-012) — distinct from the nightly LLM-free rot-watch. A source is either a SEARCH source (`query`: a GitHub search/repositories qualifier string over a covered domain) or a LIST source (`kind`:"list", `repo`: a curated awesome-list whose README is mined for the github repos it links to; optional `path` defaults to README.md). Both feed the SAME pipeline: candidates are scored (trust + safety, LLM-free) then judged (advice-neutrality + fit, LLM) before being PROPOSED for maintainer review. A list only SEEDS candidates — it never bypasses a gate. Proposal only — never auto-added (observe-never-install). Periodic + targeted (clarification 3): covered domains + known channels (curated lists, vendor orgs).

sources.query: claude code skill postgres OR prisma in:name,description,readme
claude skill terraform OR kubernetes in:name,description,readme
claude code skill playwright OR vitest in:name,description,readme
claude code skill better-auth OR lucia OR nextauth in:name,description,readme
claude skill i18n lingui OR next-intl in:name,description,readme
claude skill neovim OR nvim in:name,description,readme
claude skill proxmox OR opnsense in:name,description,readme
claude skill docker OR github-actions OR devops in:name,description,readme
